questions.q: If the Bible really is all we've said it is, what changes for you now?
questions.answer: One example: "I should actually read it more and follow what it says, even the parts that aren't convenient, instead of just saying it's important."

questions.q: How would you answer "men wrote the Bible, so how can it be God's word?"
questions.answer: Jesus is fully man and fully God, so the Bible can be written by men and still come from God, who can make sure they recorded it accurately.

questions.q: What from the last four weeks most changed how you see the Bible, and why?
questions.answer: One example: "Learning there are over 6,000 New Testament copies that agree so closely, because I had assumed it got changed a lot over time."
